game: Oath: Chronicles of Empire and Exile
scope: 2021 base first printing; Law October 20 2020 + full Playbook; official base errata November 15 2022; multiplayer, Chronicle and later setup; no bots or expansions

questions.question: An Exile takes the Oathkeeper title during their Act phase. When can they first win as Usurper, and what happens if someone takes the title away meanwhile?
List all four Oaths, their matching Visions, and the extra universal requirement for a Visionary win. Do ties for most count for a Vision?
When are end dice rolled, what results end the game, and can an Exile Oathkeeper permit such a roll?
At round eight, what is the complete victory priority including simultaneous Visions and Citizens?
Give the Successor goal for each Oath. May a Citizen win by a revealed Vision or becoming Usurper?
Resolve the People’s Favor at Wake, including the Mob side, its last favor, and when the Mob threshold is checked.
What happens in Rest, in order, and how do Citizen Supply and saved Supply work?
Explain Search sources/costs and how drawing a Vision differs between world deck and discard pile.
Where do discarded cards and resources on them go, including a card at a remote site?
How do adviser limits, facedown restrictions, revealing later, and replacing a true Vision work?
What are Muster and both Trade costs, eligible cards, gains, destinations, and limitations when no advisers match?
How do you Recover a relic versus either banner, and what happens to the old banner resources?
When is another player’s Darkest Secret safe or recoverable? Include no advisers, no cards, and a ruin-only site.
Explain legal Campaign defender and target selection, including remote sites and a same-site relic target.
How are Campaign attack/defense calculated, and how do skulls, hollow swords, ties and sacrifices work?
After an attacker wins, resolve defeat and all targets, including choosing zero garrisons, banner seizure, and banishment.
What changes in a Campaign involving Imperial defenders or a Citizen attacking another Imperial player?
State all base Travel costs and what happens when a facedown destination is revealed. How do fixed costs, increases and free Travel interact?
How can Citizenship be offered and accepted during play, and what may or must be exchanged?
Describe the Chronicle’s new Oath choice, Citizenship turnover, and world-deck rebuilding, including why the top stack is not 14 cards.
In later-game setup with five players, how much favor goes in each bank, what is on the banners, and what resources and warbands start on each kind of player board?
How is the Chronicled map dealt, where are starting Imperial garrisons placed, and which sites receive favor/secrets during later-game setup?
May later-game players choose a Citizen board or any pawn location? Does starting Citizen receive a relic, and who starts with a banner/title?
Describe later-game discard seeding, starting adviser selection and Vision counting. Are starting Reliquary relic placements chosen or random?
In first-game packet setup, which sites/pawns/garrisons/denizens/advisers are faceup or facedown, and where is Ivory Eye?
Can you act at a remote ruled site to Muster/Trade, use a normal Action power there, or use a battle plan at your pawn site that you do not rule? How do persistent powers differ?
A defensive battle plan costs favor and a secret. Where do those go when used outside your turn, when is the secret ready again, and can that plan already hold resources?
When are ordinary action modifiers used, may the same modifier apply twice to one action or to later actions, and may an active modifier be discarded?
What is the timing order for When Played powers, how often may Wake/Rest powers happen, and may a paid power be used if it will have no effect?
What do tree, person and chain restrictions do to faceup play/move/swap/discard, and how are two adviser-limit reductions combined and checked when played?
Who can play Conspiracy, what exact theft conditions/cost apply, can two advisers match one enemy adviser, and where does Conspiracy end?
May you freely discard a faceup adviser, move warbands onto an empty site, or pick up the last site warband? What changes with Citizens and co-located Imperial pawns?
What relics can you peek at without paying Supply, and may a relic peeked at earlier be inspected again after moving away?
If the Scepter holder exiles a Citizen, how is favor payment calculated, which warbands change color, and does this end the recipient’s Act?
How is self-exile paid, who is prohibited from doing it, what warbands change, and does Act continue?
Two players tie the current title holder; later the holder falls behind two tied leaders. Who holds title, and when is Supremacy transferred during Campaign?
An attack-die pool is empty and a battle plan removes an attack die. What happens? Which battle plans do bandits use and in what sequence do sides choose plans?
After skulls leave an attacking force of five warbands, the attacker loses. How many die and where do survivors go? Does winning defender take attacker’s relics?
A defender’s pawn is away from attacker and every targeted site. Do board warbands defend, and do warbands at untargeted sites defend? How are shield doubles applied?
Are warbands, favor, secrets and dice component-limited? If a requested gain exceeds a source, what is done, and can you intentionally burn extra resources?
Which game information is private and public? May a holder show a facedown adviser or lie about its identity?
How do must, cannot, ignore and must-if-able interact; which book takes priority; do a Give restriction and a Take restriction mean the same thing?
Are ordinary promises or free resource gifts binding/legal? What exceptions exist, including Reliquary relics and Tribunal?
What happens when each of the four Reliquary spaces is uncovered for Chancellor: Brutal, Decadent, Careless and Greedy?
Which winner can build or repair an edifice in Chronicle, how many, where, and may a new edifice replace a denizen at a site already holding a ruin?
In Chronicle, which sites are discarded, where do their attached cards go, and what happens to retained sites with intact edifices not ruled by winner?
Give the ordered Chronicle process for filling empty map slots, including the reverse ordering of ruins and faceup-site guarantee.
How are six Archive cards selected for world deck in Chronicle, including suit ties and no suited advisers?
If Archive cannot supply the Chronicle’s required 3/2/1 cards, is a partial allocation added, and how is the Archive healed?
What cards are eligible to become Dispossessed during Chronicle, how many are removed, and what happens to Visions and winner’s advisers?
Explain Chronicle relic cleanup order, including Grand Scepter, losing relics, site refill and winner/Reliquary relics.
How are map cards and boards packed after Chronicle, and does the next group need the same players or status ownership?
A matching-suit card is played to a Homeland site after a different-suit card was discarded there this turn. Does reward trigger, what can reward be, and how is a relic reward resolved?
How do Coast sites change Travel and interact with Narrow Pass? Is it enough that destination alone is a Coast?
When does Narrow Pass require travel to itself or an added Campaign target, and does ruling Narrow Pass change those conditions?
What must be paid to travel to Hidden Place or declare Campaign targets there, and which site powers can override this restriction?
From Buried Giant, how can you travel without Supply, where does the secret go, and does that automatically ignore Hidden Place?
How does Marshes change Search, and does it change a remote Search simply because you rule Marshes?
When may Great Slum discard a card first, and does this allow discarding there at any unrelated time?
Who chooses destination when traveling from enemy-ruled Shrouded Wood, what is its fixed cost, and does forced banishment bypass it?
Do Plains and Mountain modify dice only if the site itself is targeted, and does ruling the site cancel the modifier?
What additional warband does River grant, and what happens if you Muster there without ruling it?
Traveling from Charming Valley in Provinces normally costs how much Supply? What if a spend-no-Supply power is used?
Who may use Tribunal’s Action, what immediate resources does it let players exchange, and how is a disputed future breach resolved?
How does Bandit Crown affect empty sites, picking up last physical warband, defense and sacrificing bandits?
Can a player rule a facedown site or put cards there using a move power? What does a ruined edifice contribute to capacity, suit and action access?
Must every draw from the world deck follow the entire Search draw-stop procedure, or does the corrected Draw glossary differ? What always happens when a Vision is drawn from world deck?
Can you take several major/minor actions in any order, stop without spending all Supply, or begin another action before current one finishes?
If you seize a banner by Conspiracy or a binding transfer rather than Campaign, does it lose resources? How does Recover differ?
Can a Citizen’s defensive battle plan prohibit other Allies’ battle plans, and who decides contested order or competing use of a shared plan?
When a new Citizen’s conversion needs more purple warbands than available, who decides what is removed, and what is converted when that Citizen later becomes Exile?
If the People’s Favor is normal with five favor and its holder adds one at Wake, how many choices happen this Wake? What if it was already Mob?
Can an Exile holding an unrevealed true Vision win at Wake, or reveal it at Wake to win immediately? What if fewer than three world Visions have been drawn?
Can an Exile whose title has not yet flipped to Usurper win as Oathkeeper at end of round eight? If not, who can win instead?
At Chronicle, if Exile wins through both Usurper and Vision, must next Oath match Vision? Who may receive Chronicle Citizenship and how are accepting site garrisons replaced?
When playing through People’s Favor, must discarded and receiving sites be identical, can the discard come from another region, and can a locked card be discarded?
If a victorious attacker targeted pawn/favor and a banner, must they banish, must they burn favor, and must they take the banner? What is the rounding of board favor burn?
What do skulls do if you chose fewer attack dice than board warbands, and can you sacrifice more than required to win to reduce your upkeep?
What does the Exile/Chancellor Supply refresh depend on exactly, and how much Supply do their personal-bank brackets give before saving?
Which battle-plan box colors can attacker and defender use? Does rule alone permit a side to use the wrong-color plan?
For Chancellor/Citizen versus Exile, who is an enemy? How does an intra-Empire Campaign and the phrase your enemy change that?
May Search voluntarily draw only one of three available cards when no Vision or reducing modifier intervenes? What if source runs out?

At setup, where do the Round and Visions Drawn markers start? Who takes the first turn of every round, in which direction does play proceed, what phases make a turn, and when is an end-of-round victory check made relative to moving the round marker?

During the first-game packet setup, do players make the later-game bottom-deck adviser draws or shuffle the ordered packet world deck? How are the regional discards and the Reliquary/relic deck prepared?
Before resolving the first game’s Chronicle, how must the unopened Archive Packet be prepared?
If a power lets an Exile become a Citizen with no offer, is a Grand Scepter offer or exactly one Reliquary relic still required, and which status-conversion consequences still apply?

A normal Action/modifier card already holds favor or a secret. May you place another favor/secret on it to pay for its power? May its power still be used if it has no cost, and what special case changes the payment rule?
What mandatory defense-die bonus does the Oathkeeper title give on its Oathkeeper side versus its Usurper side? Is this a Campaign modifier, and how does Supremacy apply it to Imperial defense?

A power says to move or swap a denizen rather than play it. Must this obey site/adviser capacities and tree/person/locked restrictions? Does the movement by itself award the favor for playing to a site or trigger a When Played power?
When a Citizen’s purple warband is killed by a skull, sacrifice, or Campaign loss, which bank receives it? How does this differ from moving a defeated force’s surviving warbands?
Bandits rule more faceup sites than any player. Do they compete for the Oathkeeper or Vision goals or prevent a player from having the most sites among players?
At Salt Flats, Mine or Drowned City, when and from where may a player take income? Can they take both one favor and one secret, use a remotely ruled site, or take from a bank if that site is empty?

The attacker loses a Campaign. The defender used a battle plan saying “If you're victorious,” and both players used plans saying “At end, discard [card name].” What resolves after the roll, in what order, and does losing let the attacker keep their end-discard plan?

A battle plan you rule has a gradient power box and a ± attack-die symbol. Must an attacker add the die and a defender remove it, or may either user choose either sign? Does ± also let you change defense dice?

You have a faceup card effect beginning “Wake:” whose text contains no “may”. May you choose to skip it because it would be inconvenient, just as you can decline a “Rest:” power? Is taking Opportunity-site income at Wake compulsory too?

A Red Exile’s pawn is at a faceup site garrisoned by purple warbands, while red warbands occupy a different faceup site without their pawn. Which site and its denizen cards does Red rule? Does moving the pawn by itself change rule, and can red and purple site warbands coexist to share rule of one site?

A power tells you to reveal a facedown card, without telling you to play it. Who sees its front? Is this the same instruction as peeking, and does revealing alone award favor for site play or trigger a When Played power?

While resolving a power, an instruction says to do something “after” a specified event. May you postpone that instruction until after an intervening step of the same action? What exact timing does “after” prescribe?

Unless an effect specifies different locations, where do favor/secrets, an adviser card, and a relic move when you Take them? How does Give reverse the direction? If a power simply tells you to Burn a favor or secret, can you choose a token on a banner or card instead of your board, and where does it go?

A power permits an Exchange with a prompted player, without adding a must instruction or a binding agreement. What permission does Exchange give each player? Does the word alone require both players to transfer equal amounts in a simultaneous swap?

The previous game was packed without rebuilding the world deck. During later-game setup, may you seed the regional discards and deal starting advisers from that unrebuilt stack, then rebuild the deck afterward? At exactly what point must the deferred rebuild happen?

During first-game packet setup, how are the Chancellor and other players seated? In later-game setup, must the previous winner become Chancellor, and how are seats assigned before the other players choose boards?
Which goal reference does the first-game packet setup use, and what are its Oathkeeper and Successor goals? Does that setup allow choosing any of the four Oaths?

During the Chronicle’s edifice-ruining step, an applicable power has already kept a site that the winner does not rule. It has no intact edifice to flip. Does that step discard its denizens just because the site is retained and unruled? What actually triggers that step’s denizen discard?
